title: Dynamic Post Page with getStaticPaths
description: Create a dynamic route that statically generates individual post pages.
problemStatement:
## Goal
Extend the blog to have individual post pages using dynamic routing and static generation.

### Requirements
1. Create a file `pages/posts/[id].js`.
2. Export a default component that receives `post` as a prop and renders its `title` and `body`.
3. Export `async function getStaticPaths()` that:
   - Fetches the list of posts (same URL).
   - Maps the first 10 posts to `params: { id: post.id.toString() }`.
   - Returns `{ paths, fallback: false }`.
4. Export `async function getStaticProps({ params })` that:
   - Fetches `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/${params.id}`.
   - Returns `{ props: { post } }`.
5. From the posts list page (`pages/posts.js`), change each `<li>` to include a `<Link>` to `/posts/[id]` (e.g., `/posts/1`).

### Verification
- Build the app (`npm run build`). You should see static pages generated for `/posts/1` through `/posts/10`.
- Visit `/posts/1` – it should display the first post.
- Visiting `/posts/11` should show a 404 (since `fallback: false`).
hints: For the links in the list page, use `import Link from 'next/link'` and `<Link href={`/posts/${post.id}`}>{post.title}</Link>`.
Remember to convert `id` to string because URL params are strings.
expectedOutput: Ten static individual post pages, accessible from the blog list. Build output shows these static paths.
